consequence.statement: Only the ACME E2E tests and their Pebble test dependency changed; the evidence states no operational effect for operators.

original.statement: The ACME E2E test suite's Pebble version was upgraded to v2.7.0 and the tests adjusted; this is a test-only change with no operator-facing effect.

decision.reason: [ev-ea4a77b80f71] files this under "Other (Cleanup or Flake)". It says only that cert-manager's ACME E2E tests now use Pebble v2.7.0 and that the tests were changed to match. Nothing says any shipped component, setting or resource behaves differently, so "none" (informational, low) fits. No validator contradicts the consequence.
